RADIOLOGY REPORT Northgate Cancer and Breast Center - Breast Imaging Patient Name: Cordelia Strand DOB: 01/20/2036 MRN: ON-31-77405 Exam Date: 09/20/2060 Accession: ACC-6009-20118 Referring: Dr. Soledad Marchetti (OB) Radiologist: Dr. Anya Volkov-Reid
EXAM: Ultrasound, left breast, targeted. CLINICAL HISTORY: 24 year old woman, 24 weeks pregnant, palpable lump left breast upper outer quadrant noticed in the shower about 3 weeks ago. No nipple discharge. No family history of breast cancer, although patient's grandmother Agnes Strand, age 94, had a benign cyst removed years ago. TECHNIQUE: Real time grayscale and Doppler. Abdominal shielding used.
FINDINGS: At the 2 o'clock position, 5 cm from the nipple, there is an oval, circumscribed, parallel, hypoechoic mass measuring 1.4 x 0.9 x 1.1 cm. Mild posterior enhancement. Internal vascularity is minimal. No calcifications, no architectural distortion. Left axilla: normal lymph nodes. Right breast not examined.
IMPRESSION: Probable benign fibroadenoma versus lactational change, BI-RADS category 3 (probably benign). Recommend short interval follow-up ultrasound in 6 months, or oncology review.
PERTINENT HISTORY (copied forward): Patient is a 24 y.o. female, G1P0. Smoker: no. Medications: ethinyl estradiol/drospirenone pill (stopped 10/11/2058). Report dictated by A.
